# Dish: a shallow eight-sided ceramic bowl 1.9 m across, 0.4 m tall, for the spare marbles.
# Origin on the ground under its centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Glaze --base-color 0.9412 0.3569 0.3569 --no-slot
material new Inside --base-color 0.9216 0.4235 0.5961 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Dish --vertices 8 --radius1 0.62 --radius2 0.95 --depth 0.4 --location 0 0 0.2
material assign Glaze
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
inset 0.12
extrude 0 0 -0.26
material assign Inside
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 && pos.z < -0.15"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export dish.glb
